sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No statement about this variety. Gives the history of the Bandung Doofstommen Instituut / SLB Cicendo (pdf pp. 118-123) and analyses grammatical variation (completion, negation) in modern BISINDO of Solo and Makassar. Only generic remarks that sign-language prosody parallels 'the rhythms, stresses and intonation of speech' through non-manual markers (pdf p. 18; similar p. 95, citing Sandler, Crasborn).
